resolved_findings.resolution: Wire5 validation binds exact whole-request identity, base/draft/epoch, returns bounded proposedSource/hash, and maps diagnostics back to submitted IDs. UI2 requires matching retained request/candidate before adopting preview. SOURCE adds exact-source checks. No advisory preview is acceptance authority.

Closed schemas, exact set-valued parameters, unique ownership forest, explicit scope/call validation, named structural equivalence, stable occurrence roles/comment-copy transport, scalar-aligned source mapping and separate artifact/revision/presentation envelopes resolve prior design ambiguity. Canonical context association stays separate from anonymous Boolean proof and presentation IDs.

Inspected source separates raw decoded intent from checked policy-dependent artifact, allows direct revision0 lookup with fresh report/content preservation, models lost denial acknowledgements, and exposes replay/collision/auth-denial without requiring new parser work. Matching theorem inventory binds the frozen source.

TEXT_ONLY commands use stored opaque descriptor keys rather than nonexistent block IDs; immutable replay returns exact original envelope with optional separate transport header and a separate current-head read.

design_assessment.scope: Bounded static exact-nominal fragment is sufficiently explicit to implement. Forest ownership removes DAG lexical-environment ambiguity; all incoming declaration dependencies and predicate ranks are rechecked. Full tag distinctions are retained.
design_assessment.projection: Adapter specifies pinned AST forms, authored-command token recovery before solver expansion, limited normalization, exact source bytes, optional unavailable locations and source-supported elaboration. Ambiguous adapters cannot fabricate BLOCK_SUPPORTED authority. Trivia transfer is explicit and independently validated.
design_assessment.canonical: Presentation UUIDs/names do not leak into retrieval embeddings. Existing anonymous profile must be bound to checked artifact/source/policy and exact context/atoms; TEXT_ONLY, unsupported association and unavailable-budget results cannot create document-authoritative pairs.
design_assessment.freshness: Draft/accepted separation, request-bound previews, inverse diagnostic mapping and content-generation versus presentation epoch form an implementable UI reducer contract. Late results cannot replace newer drafts or badge mismatched evidence.
design_assessment.security_and_persistence: Nonce-fenced admissions, workspace-first locks, policy fencing, exact-byte receipts before stale/quota, indefinite bounded retention and proxy-only persistence are coherent specified adapter obligations.

formal_assessment.claim: Approval of exact bounded propositions and their declared trust/gameplan, not an independent proof-build result. Two clean registered builds remain required before production edits.
boundaries: Finite23-tag witnesses are not universal Java/TypeScript checker refinement.
Parser/lexer/printer/source-location, UUID/forest adapter and field cardinality remain tested trusted components.
Serialized Lean transitions do not prove database linearizability, RLS, nonce recovery, physical capacity or browser correctness.
Unknown branches model successful or denial receipt acknowledgement loss; clients must still treat unknown as uncertain, not infer a durable outcome.

required_execution_order: Register frozen propositions and complete two clean isolated proof builds against preserved baseline before production edits.
Implement and execute the specified finite server/SQL/receipt/recovery/policy tests, then full source/palette/projection/UI/accessibility and performance acceptance.
Report each inherited G2/G3 and G0-G6 gate independently, retaining failures and unmet requirements.
commercial_assessment: Engineering gameplan approval only. No release, commercial deployment, dataset rights, upstream redistribution, accessibility conformance, performance or market-demand claim. Existing SQL/retrieval evidence remains preserved and cannot substitute for document runtime evidence.
verification_performed: Verified SHA256 of all six files against frozen manifest.

approval_scope: APPROVE_GAMEPLAN for the exact six input hashes only, contingent on the already required council and two clean formal-build sequence before production. No runtime, G2/G3 or commercial closure.
